landing.heroTitle: For fans who go to matches — not only from the sofa
landing.heroBody: I Watch Football is for supporters who actually attend games. Ticketing sites help you buy a seat; stats apps show generic match data — none of them build your personal football history.
landing.pillarsSubtitle: Everything connects back to the matches you've actually been to.
landing.pillarHistoryBody: Build a record of the matches you've attended — grounded in real attendance — automatically enriched with context so it becomes more than a list of fixtures.
landing.pillarInsightsBody: Discover stats tied to your stands: which player you've seen score the most, the club you've watched most often, or which stadium has hosted the most goals in your history.
landing.pillarTicketsBody: Our ticket marketplace connects getting in the door with your match history — turning one-off transactions into long-term engagement with your own data.
landing.pillarAttendanceBody: Log the matches you attend and build a personal record that grows richer over time — grounded in real attendance, not generic stats.
landing.pillarFriendsBody: See how your attendance stacks up against friends. Who's the most travelled fan? Who's seen the most goals live? Now you'll know.
landing.pillarFollowBody: Get notified about results, upcoming fixtures, and news for every club you've watched — all in one place, tied to your history.
landing.pillarStadiumsBody: Build a map of every ground you've set foot in. Discover facts, photos, and memories tied to each venue across your journey.
landing.pillarAwayBody: Track every away trip you've made. The miles, the cities, the clubs visited — your dedication as a travelling supporter, all recorded.
landing.pillarTicketHistoryBody: Upload past and future tickets to keep a permanent archive. Never lose proof of a match you were at again.
landing.whyWeBuiltBody: The idea came from travelling across Europe with family to watch football — loving the ritual of being there, but missing a product that answered one simple question: across every match I've attended, what's my football story?
landing.founderQuote: "I'm naturally data-driven; nothing out there connected tickets, attendance, and personal narratives in one place. I Watch Football is our answer."
